allocation_rule: q,r=divmod(N,P); m[p]=q+1 for p<r, otherwise q; p=0..P-1
raan_rule: Omega[p]=(360*p/P) mod 360; core accumulates equal 360/P increments
phase_rule: u[p,s]=(360*s/m[p]+360*F*p/N) mod 360; p and s start at zero
phase_factor_rule: If N is divisible by P, P is even and N/P is odd: F=0 when P=2, otherwise F=2; all other cases F=1
temporary_assumptions: UTCG is provisional: the task specifies calendar times but no time system.
Constants reused from archived famou orbit.py; its STK 11.6 provenance claim is historical evidence, not a current native or official confirmation.
Mean Earth radius 6371.0 km defines altitude only; J2 reference radius is 6378.1363 km.
First-order secular J2 SSO relation with tropical year 365.2421897 days; mean/osculating initial-element alignment and long-term nodal drift require native verification.
Fixed 600 km, zero global RAAN/phase origin, nearest sqrt(2*N) planes and the explicit parity phase rule are deterministic engineering choices, not performance-optimal results.
The parity rule removes initial node coincidences found with F=1 for N=2,18,50,98. Initial position checks do not certify long-term collision safety.
Unequal populations use a custom balanced family with the stated phase rule, not a standard equal-population Walker claim.
No LTAN/LTDN constraint is supplied or inferred.
No payload or point grid is instantiated by this generator; official FOV interpretation, regions, Earth/EOP and interface formatting remain external confirmation items.
